titleEn: The Day Pongi Had a Cold

pages.text: Pongi's nose was blocked. Her voice sounded funny.
She could hear the children outside the window. "I want to go out too."
"You need to stay in bed today." Mom tucked the blanket around her.
Dad came into the room. "If you can't play outside, you can play inside."
Dad made a boat out of the blanket. He used a pillow to row.
Dad pulled over a chair and made a bridge. The bedroom floor became a canal.
Pongi laughed, then coughed. Cough, cough.
Mom opened the door. The whole room was a mess.
Mom pushed Dad down to lie beside the blanket. Pongi was already lying down.
They lay side by side. Dad fell asleep first.
